description: This file defines classes and functions for implementing Server-Sent Events (SSE) in a FastAPI application, including response classes, data models, and utility functions for formatting SSE events.

classes.name: ServerSentEvent
classes.description: Represents a single Server-Sent Event with JSON serialization and validation.

classes.name: EventSourceResponse
classes.description: A StreamingResponse subclass that sets the media type for SSE.

methods.name: _check_id_no_null
methods.description: Validates that the 'id' does not contain null characters.

methods.name: format_sse_event
methods.description: Constructs a byte string representing an SSE event in wire format from pre-serialized data.
